card.name: Digits inside ISBN, ISSN and phone numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or a hyphen or separator inside long identifier-style number strings such as ISBNs, ISSNs, DOIs and toll-free phone numbers. It also fires on a unit or space right after a number like 10.

modes.label: Zero or hyphen in ID numbers
modes.description: A 0 or hyphen partway through an ISBN, ISSN, DOI or 800 phone number.
modes.example: Linear Statistics, Theory & Methods, Wiley. ISBN 978-0-47<<0>>-01562-9

modes.label: Separator after a number
modes.description: A space, slash or unit such as mg or mL right after a number like 10 in tables or dose equivalences.
modes.example: of ceftobiprole; 13.3 mg/kg ceftobiprole medocaril sodium is equivalent to 10<< mg>>/kg of ceftobiprole.

card.writes: It seems to push toward more digits or number-continuing pieces, mainly in Chinese number words, and away from age or approximation words.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle digits of catalogue, journal and phone numbers, and on the gap after a number like 10.
